response.original_title: A Step-to-Step® How to Cancel Avast Plan & Stop Auto Renewal?
response.overview: If you want to cancel your Avast plan and stop auto renewal, call the Avast Support Team at ((+1-(866).465.1368)) for the fastest, most direct help. A representative can review your subscription, confirm your renewal date, and guide you through cancellation. Calling is the quickest way to get help, and the line is available 24/7 for assistance.  Speak Directly with Avast Customer Support Cancelling a plan on your own can be confusing, especially when auto renewal settings are buried in account menus. Instead of guessing, call the Avast Support Team at ((+1-(866).465.1368)) and explain what you need. Customer Support can verify your account details and tell you exactly what to do next. This saves time and prevents unwanted charges.
